sources.entry: 10. PhotoAI - AI for various photo editing tasks.

summary.name: photoai.app
summary.one_liner: photoai.app is a premium .app domain name listed for sale at $19,999, not a photo editing tool itself.
use_cases: lease a premium domain in installments
summary.what_it_does: The page offers the domain photoai.app for sale at $19,999 USD via a Buy Now button. It also offers a lease-to-own option of 24 installments at $959 per month, letting the buyer use the domain while paying. The page describes .app as a TLD backed by Google that requires HTTPS for websites. It contains no description of any photo editing software or features, despite being listed under AI photo editing tools.
notable: Domain offered for $19,999 USD with lease-to-own option (24 x $959/month)
The .app TLD requires HTTPS for all websites
Page is a domain sale listing, not a software product
caveats: Listed as an AI photo editing tool in awesome-ai-tools, but the page itself describes only a domain for sale
Domain is sold, not a software tool; no product features are described
